checks.name: Owner reads four independent safe facts without triggering model/provider work
Website-only corrections use the editing token and preserve reviewed business rules
Malformed, stale, unapproved and router-fragment starts reject without a challenge or model
One-time URL is bound and absent from the safe owner DTO or stored raw material
Observation requires exact external origin and changes no readiness, review or allowance
Only an explicit public send uses the ordinary allowance and saves a labeled actual request
Duplicate logical sends and forged acknowledgments cannot spend or invent completion
Exact record rebinding blocks acknowledgment and cannot produce green owner evidence
A missing evidence projection reconciles the same saved request without model replay
A valid post-done acknowledgment qualifies the exact request and is idempotent
Setup records remain visible and labeled while customer reports and customer export exclude them
Question-only done acknowledgment is not a completed request check
Expired/revoked session and changed config reject before model spending
A failed final model response retains its actual saved request as unconfirmed
Setup contact without check metadata is blocked; ordinary external request uses normal handler
Changing selected website keeps the earlier site request historical until a current-site request exists
Replacing a workspace incarnation cannot inherit installation/check/first-request evidence
